listings.title: Residential and light-commercial HVAC service company
listings.financing: Seller will carry up to 10% of the price
listings.description: Established heating and air-conditioning contractor serving homeowners and small commercial clients. Roughly 40% of revenue comes from maintenance agreements that renew each spring. Licensed technicians, a dispatcher and an office manager run day-to-day operations; the owner handles estimating and supplier relationships.
highlights: Nine service vans included in the sale
Owner will stay six months for transition

listings.title: Neighbourhood cafe and bakery with wholesale accounts
listings.description: Busy corner cafe with an in-house bakery that also supplies pastries to six local grocers and offices. Ten-year lease with renewal option, fully equipped kitchen and a trained head baker who intends to stay.
highlights: Wholesale accounts add about 18% of sales

listings.title: Shopify home-goods brand with repeat customers
listings.description: Direct-to-consumer brand selling kitchen and home textiles through its own store and a marketplace channel. Products are made by two long-standing suppliers. An email list and returning buyers generate a large share of orders, reducing reliance on paid ads.
highlights: Returning customers drive about 45% of orders
Runs on roughly 20 owner hours a week

listings.title: B2B scheduling software with annual contracts
listings.description: Appointment and staff-scheduling software used by clinics and service businesses. Most customers pay annually. Hosting costs are low and a part-time developer maintains the code base.
highlights: Most revenue billed annually in advance

listings.title: Physiotherapy clinic with three treatment rooms
listings.financing: Vendor finance available on part of the price
listings.description: Well-reviewed clinic serving sports, workplace and post-surgery patients. Referral relationships with local GPs and sports clubs. Associate physiotherapists are on contracts and the practice software holds full patient history.

listings.title: Commercial cleaning company with multi-year contracts
listings.financing: SBA-friendly; seller open to a standby note
listings.description: Janitorial company cleaning offices, medical suites and property-management portfolios at night. Supervisors manage crews; the owner focuses on sales and client relationships. Contracts typically run one to three years.

listings.title: Boutique fitness studio franchise resale
listings.description: Membership-based studio in a busy retail centre with an established coaching team. The resale includes equipment, the membership base and the remaining franchise term. Transfer requires franchisor approval and training.
highlights: Remaining franchise term over six years
Head coach and front-desk manager in place

listings.title: Licensed childcare centre with waitlist
listings.financing: Bank financing; seller will assist with licensing transfer
listings.description: Licensed centre for infants through school age with a full enrolment and an active waitlist. Qualified educators, a centre director and documented policies make this a manager-run operation.

listings.title: Auto repair shop with building included
listings.financing: Suitable for SBA financing with real estate
listings.description: General repair and maintenance shop with six bays and strong online reviews. The sale includes the building and lot. Fleet accounts with local businesses supply a steady base of work.
highlights: Six bays and two lifts recently replaced

listings.title: Salon and spa in a premium shopping district
listings.description: Hair, skin and spa services with a loyal client base and a membership package programme. Fully fitted premises, trained stylists and an appointment system with client history.
